description: 后兵对后 — 黑方永续将军，和棋

intro.popup_en: A perpetual-check draw: White's g-pawn is about to promote, protected by the queen on c2 and king on h8. Black's resource is to keep checking so the white queen must defend instead of helping the pawn promote.
intro.popup:
🛡️ 永续将军求和
白兵g7即将升变，白后c2护卫，白王h8。
黑方妙手：黑后不断将军，白后疲于应付，无法升变！

outro.popup_en: Draw by perpetual check. Whatever White tries, the black queen can keep checking until the position repeats three times.
outro.popup: 🤝 永续将军，和棋！无论白方如何应对，黑后都能不断将军——局面重复三次，和棋。

moves.popup_en: The black queen checks the white king.
The white queen blocks the check while also protecting the g7-pawn's promotion.
moves.popup: 白后h7挡将——同时掩护g7兵升变。

moves.popup_en: The black queen changes direction and checks again.
The white pawn promotes while the black queen is away.
moves.popup: ♟ 白兵升变！白方利用黑后移开的瞬间升变。

moves.popup_en: The black queen immediately checks the newly promoted queen.
The new white queen blocks the check on g7.
The black queen returns to h4 with check, repeating the first position.
moves.popup: 🔄 黑后回到h4将军，局面与第1步相同！

moves.popup_en: The white queen blocks again on h7.
The position repeats for the third time. Black draws by perpetual check and neutralizes the promotion threat.
moves.popup: 🔄 第三次重复！永续将军，和棋。黑方成功化解升变威胁。
